title: Firewall flowtables input validation hardening
acceptance_criteria: Flowtable batch endpoint rejects invalid flowtable names with explicit 400 errors.
Flowtable batch endpoint enforces an operation allowlist and rejects unknown operations with 400.
Flowtable batch endpoint validates required values per operation and rejects missing/blank values with 400.
Flowtable batch endpoint validates interface-name values for interface operations and rejects invalid names with 400.
Flowtable batch endpoint validates offload values and accepts only hardware/software, normalizing mixed-case input to canonical lowercase values.
Flowtable delete endpoint validates path flowtable name and rejects invalid names with 400.
Regression tests cover invalid and valid flowtable batch/delete paths.
assumptions: Allowed flowtable names follow ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$ for safe command generation.
Allowed interface names follow ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,62}$ and include common VyOS interface formats.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added backend validation helpers and fail-fast 400 responses for flowtable batch/delete inputs.
Added regression tests for invalid names, invalid offload/interface values, missing required values, valid flowtable batch, and invalid delete input.
Manual review completed (reviewer sub-agent unavailable due thread cap). APPROVED with one follow-up fix applied: lowercase normalization for offload values before command generation.
